prerequisites: Ability to read and comprehend documentation written in English.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to use and develop methodologies, methods, techniques, specific use programs, norms and standards of computer graphics.
Ability for the creation and exploitation of virtual environments, and for the creation, management and distribution of multimedia content.
Know the basic foundations of graphics systems and the most frequent rendering processes.
Analyze and understand the main three-dimensional modeling schemes.
Combine modeling and visualization techniques to synthesize quality images.
Know the types of multimedia systems, applications and services, as well as the technologies involved in them.
Analyze the requirements of multimedia services.
Design, develop, configure and evaluate multimedia services.

syllabus_topics: Continuous media distribution: architecture and technologies.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, students must achieve at least 5 out of 10 points in the theoretical exam, practical work, and group work. The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Group_Work + 0.3 * Practical_Work + 0.2 * Theoretical_Exam. If any minimum is not met, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary assessment, if previous grades in practical and group work were 5 or higher, they are retained; otherwise, they become 0. The final grade is calculated as 0.4 * (0.6 * Group_Work + 0.4 * Practical_Work) + 0.6 * Theoretical_Exam, with the same minimum grade condition. For differentiated assessment, the calculation is the same as the ordinary assessment but for individual work, and a minimum of 5 points in each component is required.
